context.issue_text: No seeded QA login credentials for tenant-business persona actors (actor-swiftroute-lena/marco/alice and equivalents) -- blocks GUI-driven narrative UAT scenarios that need a tenant-specific human role. Suggested fix: (a) seed stable QA users with correct role claims; or (b) scripted provisioning. Note: ISS-0774 resolved -- role_from_string now works; a user with TASK_WORKER + role-ops-manager CAN authenticate and complete tasks after ISS-0774's fix.

## STEP 1 — Root Cause Diagnosis

The issue: no seeded QA login credentials for SwiftRoute persona actors (Lena/Marco/Alice with role-ops-manager/role-ceo). This blocks end-to-end UAT for REQ-395 and other SwiftRoute scenarios.

Context:
- ISS-0774 (now resolved): Authorization.role_from_string/1's closed set now allows process-routing-role-only users to get a proper 403 (they cannot authenticate for platform API without a platform role). The fix added a `kind` column to tenant_role.
- After ISS-0774: a user needs BOTH a platform role (like TASK_WORKER) AND a process routing role (like role-ops-manager) to work as a SwiftRoute persona actor.
- The current gap: no such combined-role users exist in the QA Keycloak realm.

Diagnose:
1. Read docs/issues/ISS-0739.yaml for the full issue description
2. Read .claude/agents/uat-runner.md for how UAT-RUNNER resolves actors to credentials
3. Read lib/letflow/api/authorization.ex lines around role_from_string/1 to confirm ISS-0774 fix is in place
4. Understand what infrastructure is needed to provision a QA user with:
   a. A Keycloak account (username/password)
   b. Role claim 'TASK_WORKER' (platform role, for API authorization)
   c. A tenant_role entry with `kind: :process_routing_role` for 'role-ops-manager' (for task routing)
5. Determine the fix path -- specifically:
   a. Is there already a QA provisioning mechanism in scripts/ (we just wrote scripts/seed_swiftroute_definition.sh -- look at what API it uses)
   b. Does letflow expose any API for user/tenant management that could create these users programmatically?
   c. What is the minimum scope change to unblock REQ-395's AC2/AC3 verification?

Key question: Is the fix:
- (A) An `ai-dala-infra` change (add users to qa-login.sh) -- EXTERNAL to this repo
- (B) A letflow script that calls the QA API to create test users with the right roles
- (C) A documentation update to .claude/agents/uat-runner.md documenting an alternative auth approach
- (D) Some combination

Report your diagnosis including:
- Root cause (confirmed, with evidence)
- Fix path recommendation with rationale
- Which files need to change
- Any open questions

Complete your handoff (step-01-issue-fixer.json): status COMPLETED, result.status with your diagnosis.

step_0_5_registry_lookup.recurrence_assessment: ISS-0739 is NOT a recurrence of any prior resolved issue. It is the original, never-resolved credential-provisioning gap. The resolved issues above (ISS-0768, ISS-0773, ISS-0774, ISS-0778) collectively fixed the letflow-side infrastructure so that persona actors CAN work — but none of them seeded the actual QA Keycloak accounts or letflow group memberships that are ISS-0739's own scope.

summary.root_cause: Tri-layer provisioning gap — all three layers required for a SwiftRoute persona actor to authenticate and receive tasks are absent. The root cause is not a code defect but missing QA data across two repositories (ai-dala-infra + letflow). Evidence from three source reads and four resolved sibling issues confirms this structural analysis.

layers.description: ai-dala-infra/scripts/qa-login.sh's ROLE_FOR map contains only the six platform-role users (admin-user, designer-user, operator-user, worker-user, candidate-user, bilimbaga-admin-user). No entries exist for swiftroute-lena (dispatcher), swiftroute-marco (ops manager), or swiftroute-alice (CEO). Without a Keycloak account + stable qa-login.sh entry, UAT-RUNNER has no credential_source resolution path for any actor-swiftroute-* actor. This is the primary blocking layer.
layers.evidence: docs/issues/ISS-0739.yaml description; .claude/agents/uat-runner.md 'Environment target' section documents credential_source as the authoritative source of seeded credentials; ISS-0739.yaml affected_files lists ai-dala-infra/scripts/qa-login.sh as the primary file.

layers.description: The swiftroute tenant schema needs tenant_role rows with kind: :process_routing_role for 'role-ops-manager' and 'role-ceo', each bound to a group. These are NOT auto-created by definition deployment (seed_swiftroute_definition.sh only calls POST /definitions + POST /definitions/:id/activate — no role creation). RoleRegistry.resolve_role_in_tx/1 (role_registry.ex:210-220) only READs; if the row is absent it returns nil. The Engine uses this at task-assignment time — nil means the assigned-group is nil, causing the task to be unclaimable by anyone matching that role.
layers.evidence: lib/letflow/identity/role_registry.ex resolve_role_in_tx/1 (line ~210): pure read, never creates. scripts/seed_swiftroute_definition.sh lines 1-140: deploys definition only, zero POST /roles calls. upsert_role/4 (role_registry.ex) is the only write path for tenant_role rows, called exclusively via POST /identity/roles.

layers.domain: Letflow group membership + platform role coverage
layers.description: After ISS-0774's fix (confirmed in place: identity.ex:703 `where: tr.kind == :platform_role`), list_effective_role_names/2 returns ONLY platform-role bindings for Authorization. A process-routing-role-only user gets 403 on all platform API routes by design. Therefore, each persona actor ALSO needs a TASK_WORKER platform role — either (a) present as a Keycloak claim (synced automatically on first login by sync_role_claims_from_token/3, which now correctly retries if zero grants resolved per ISS-0773's fix), or (b) added directly via POST /groups/:id/members. Additionally, each actor must be a member of their role's group (POST /groups/:id/members) so their task inbox resolves correctly. The OIDC sync path (resolve_group_ids_for_role_names) is filtered to kind == :platform_role only (ISS-0775 fix at identity.ex:832), so role-ops-manager group membership cannot be auto-synced from a token claim — it must be explicitly provisioned.
layers.evidence: lib/letflow/identity.ex:703 (list_effective_role_names kind filter, confirmed via grep), identity.ex:832 (resolve_group_ids_for_role_names kind filter for OIDC sync). ISS-0774 resolution confirms platform-role-only-user 403 is correct by design. ISS-0778 resolution confirms seed_default_platform_role_groups/1 is wired into TenantOnboarding.provision_and_migrate/1 for new tenants.

summary.iss_0774_evidence: lib/letflow/identity.ex line 703: `where: gm.user_id == ^user_id and tr.kind == :platform_role`. Confirmed via Select-String on main branch. role_from_string/1 (authorization.ex:447-453) unchanged — still a closed 6-element set — but this is correct post-ISS-0774: process-routing roles never pass through role_from_string/1.

fix_path.recommendation: D — combination of ai-dala-infra change (Part A) + letflow QA provisioning script (Part B) + uat-runner.md update (Part C). All three are required; Parts A and B are independently releasable but only the combination unblocks end-to-end UAT.

parts.description: Add stable QA users for the SwiftRoute persona trio to Keycloak and to qa-login.sh's ROLE_FOR/VAR_FOR maps. Each user needs a Keycloak account with: (1) username/password stable for QA, (2) TASK_WORKER role claim (for platform API authorization — required post-ISS-0774), (3) optionally role-ops-manager/role-ceo as a claim (harmless — won't be synced to group membership, but may help with future extensions). Minimum: swiftroute-lena (dispatcher, TASK_WORKER), swiftroute-marco (ops manager, TASK_WORKER), swiftroute-alice (CEO, TASK_WORKER). This is outside the letflow repo's scope — must be a separate ai-dala-infra task.

A new idempotent shell script (matching seed_swiftroute_definition.sh's established pattern) that provisions the process-routing-role infrastructure and group memberships for SwiftRoute persona actors. Steps: (1) GET /identity/roles — check if role-ops-manager and role-ceo process_routing_role rows exist; create via POST /identity/roles with kind: process_routing_role if not. (2) GET /identity/roles — check TASK_WORKER platform_role row; create if not (covers pre-ISS-0778 swiftroute tenant). (3) For each persona user: GET /identity/users?username=swiftroute-marco — look up their user_id. (4) POST /groups/:id/members for each user+group pair (role-ops-manager group, role-ceo group, TASK_WORKER group). (5) Call GET /identity/groups/:id/members to verify membership. Prerequisites: QA_AUTH_TOKEN (PLATFORM_ADMIN for swiftroute tenant), QA_URL. Must be called AFTER seed_swiftroute_definition.sh (definition must exist so swiftroute tenant exists) and AFTER Part A (Keycloak accounts must exist so GET /identity/users resolves them).

Update the 'Environment target' section to explicitly state that SwiftRoute/Vortex/Meridian tenant-persona actors (actor-swiftroute-lena, actor-swiftroute-marco, actor-swiftroute-alice, and their equivalents) are resolved via ai-dala-infra/scripts/qa-login.sh the same way platform-role actors are, and that their Keycloak accounts require both a TASK_WORKER platform claim AND membership in their respective process-routing-role group (provisioned via scripts/seed_swiftroute_persona_actors.sh). This documents the gap explicitly so it cannot be rediscovered for a fourth time.

fix_path.minimal_unblock_for_REQ_395_AC4: Part A (ai-dala-infra Keycloak seeding) + Part B (letflow group membership provisioning) together. Part C is hygiene but not strictly blocking the specific UAT re-run. REQ-395's AC2/AC3 (instance submission + task-state verification) do NOT require persona actors — they can be exercised with any InstancesStart-capable token (PROCESS_OPERATOR or PLATFORM_ADMIN). REQ-395 is already status: done. The remaining gap is exclusively AC4 (re-run the scenario shipment-high-value-happy.yaml end-to-end with real sign-in as ops-manager/CEO actors), which blocks on ISS-0739's resolution.
